anchor: ClearSkyPV fitted on all development records (349,372; all 497 dev days)
tau_definition: 90th percentile of |K(t+15)-K(t)| over all 164,362 development samples
event_formula: ramp iff |K(t+15) - K(t)| >= tau_test, K = PV / max(P_clear, 1 kW), K(t+15) at the matched target record, K(t) at the origin record
